name: positional-member-codes
description: A positional member carries manual fixability and a component that removes no line whatever code its references select: a constant only a test file's constant names, and that test file's constant, whose deletion renumbers a constant only that test file names. A first constant whose list a later named one repeats is retained by the enum-group class instead, because removing it alone does not compile, whichever code its references would select: an exported constant of an importable package nothing references, an exported constant of a command, a constant only a test references and a constant carrying a deprecation marker among them. So is a constant whose deletion renumbers a named iota constant, and an interface only that constant's expression names stays live with it, its method reported as one no call invokes.
